description:
## 1.0.0 (2026-11-21)

### ✨ New Features

* Add Google Authenticator patches ([6a6de90](https://github.com/OmarBrbutovic/merak-patches/commit/6a6de90f0131f8dc485e911bf6e2da0e8a8675ce))

patches.name: Account organizer
patches.description: Adds categories to organize accounts, shown as folders or as cards. Switch layouts and manage categories from the bar above the account list.

patches.name: Custom branding
patches.description: Changes the app name and launcher icon, so the patched app is easy to tell apart from the original Google Authenticator.

options.description: The name of the app on the home screen and in the app list.
Background color of the launcher icon, behind the Authenticator mark. Not used when a custom icon is set.

Optional square image (PNG, JPG or WEBP) to use as the whole launcher icon instead. The launcher crops it to its icon shape, so keep important content away from the edges. 432 x 432 pixels or larger is recommended.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Allows signing in with a Google Account and using Google Account sync by using GmsCore (MicroG-RE) instead of Google Play services. The app is installed under a different package name, so it can be installed next to the original app.

options.description: The package name of the patched app. It must be different from the original package name.
